0022600114.text: The Knicks host the Orlando Magic in New York's third game of the season, with both teams still searching for their first win: New York is 0-2 (0-1 at home) and sits 12th in the East and 5th in the Atlantic, 2 games back, while Orlando is also 0-2 (0-2 at home), 14th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, 2 games back. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but they split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and New York won the most recent meeting 132-120 in Orlando. Orlando will be without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Anthony Black is listed as day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision.
